topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: Oh no, I can't believe this happened. I remember the day you planted that tree, how excited you were, how you talked about watching it grow alongside you. It felt like a symbol, you know? A reminder of all the good things that could come from just putting a little effort in. I wish I could've done something, maybe made a difference. Now that it's gone, everything feels different. I keep thinking about all the times we spent there, under its branches, and it's like a piece of our past is just... missing. I'm so sorry, truly. I wish I could change it, undo it all. But I can’t. All I can do is be here for you, as always.
